---
title: "Cleaning: Filosofi income and commune list"
author: "Marwa Fani and Salma Sbihi"
format: html
---

```{r}
here::i_am("Charm-Prices.Rproj")
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

filo_raw <- read_delim(here("data", "raw", "filosofi_2021_data.csv"),
                       delim = ";", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

glimpse(filo_raw)
```
```{r}
filo_raw |> count(GEO_OBJECT)

filo_raw |> distinct(FILOSOFI_MEASURE) |> print(n = 50)
```
```{r}
filo_sel <- filo_raw |>
  filter(GEO_OBJECT == "COM",
         FILOSOFI_MEASURE %in% c("MED_SL", "PR_MD60"))

filo_sel |> count(FILOSOFI_MEASURE, UNIT_MEASURE)

filo_sel |> count(GEO, FILOSOFI_MEASURE) |> filter(n > 1)
```
```{r}
filo <- filo_sel |>
  mutate(OBS_VALUE = as.numeric(OBS_VALUE)) |>
  select(commune = GEO, measure = FILOSOFI_MEASURE, value = OBS_VALUE) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = value) |>
  rename(median_living_standard = MED_SL,
         poverty_rate = PR_MD60)

glimpse(filo)
```

```{r}
filo |>
  summarise(
    n_communes = n(),
    hidden_median = sum(is.na(median_living_standard)),
    hidden_poverty = sum(is.na(poverty_rate)),
    share_hidden_poverty = mean(is.na(poverty_rate))
  )
```
```{r}
dir.create(here("data", "clean"), showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(filo, here("data", "clean", "filosofi.csv"))
```

```{r}
cog_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "v_commune_2025.csv"),
                    col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

glimpse(cog_raw)
```
```{r}
cog <- cog_raw |>
  filter(TYPECOM == "COM") |>
  select(commune = COM, name = LIBELLE, department = DEP, region = REG)

glimpse(cog)
cog |> count(commune) |> filter(n > 1)
```
```{r}
write_csv(cog, here("data", "clean", "cog.csv"))

# Filosofi codes that are NOT in the COG
filo |> anti_join(cog, by = "commune") |> nrow()

# COG codes that are NOT in Filosofi
cog |> anti_join(filo, by = "commune") |> nrow()
```
```{r}
missing_filo <- cog |> anti_join(filo, by = "commune")

missing_filo |> count(department, sort = TRUE)

missing_filo |> slice_head(n = 15)
```
71 communes of the COG 2025 have no Filosofi data: all are in Guadeloupe, French Guiana and Mayotte. They are excluded from the income analysis.
